claims.text: The lower-adjoined family \(\{\bar s_\mu:i^j\subseteq\mu\subseteq(i^j,b^a)\}\) is minimally generating. [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 220-235]

**Indecomposable-basis lemma.** Let \(A=\bigoplus_{d\ge0}A_d\) be a graded \(\mathbb Z\)-algebra with \(A_0=\mathbb Z\), let \(J\) be a graded ideal, and let \(G\subset J\) be a finite homogeneous generating set. If the residue classes of \(G\) are \(\mathbb Z\)-linearly independent in \(Q:=J/A_+J\), then they are a homogeneous \(\mathbb Z\)-basis of \(Q\). Consequently \(Q\) is torsion-free and \(\operatorname{Hilb}_Q(z)=\sum_{g\in G}z^{\deg g}\).
Minimality of \(G\) alone does not imply the independence hypothesis of the indecomposable-basis lemma.
